patterns: PBD is the most-asked item: date (9 January), first year (2003), host city of a given edition, Samman recipients.
Peacekeeping asked as statement items on force (self-defence AND mandate), who withdraws a mission (UNSC), largest budget contributor (USA), and mission-host-period matches (UPSC 2026).
APPSC items here are current-affairs one-liners (ICCR Distinguished Indologist award) rather than conceptual diplomacy.
Old keys (UPPSC 2011: India biggest troop contributor) are dated - app correctly teaches the current rank as a trap.
App has more institution-year items (ITEC 1964, EXIM 1982, DPA 2012) and operation-country matches - reasonable exam fodder.
